observed_behavior: The pinned Overlay implementation defines required onClickOutside, onEscape, and returnFocusRef props, plus optional initialFocusRef, preventFocusOnOpen and ignoreClickRefs; it calls imported useOverlay with these callback/ref inputs. Overlay defaults its role to 'none' and visibility to 'visible', renders BaseOverlay with role/visibility/width/height/responsive props, and uses Portal by default. It bypasses Portal only when both _PrivateDisablePortal and the primer_react_css_anchor_positioning feature flag are true; its comment distinguishes native top-layer placement from style isolation. Other visible effects set a measured initial height and attempt an entry animation when an anchor-side vector exists, animate is available, and visibility is not hidden. These are source branches and delegated API wiring.
